modules.name: Reinforced Armor Plating
modules.description: Welded steel plates bolted to chassis and cabin for direct ballistic and shrapnel protection.

modules.name: Ballistic Glass Panes
modules.description: Multi-layer polycarbonate and tempered laminate windshield and side windows.

modules.name: Extended Bed Frame
modules.description: Lengthened bed rails and reinforced suspension leaves for carrying bulk wasteland salvage.

modules.name: Heavy Hauler Trailer
modules.description: Towed dual-axle flatbed trailer providing massive cargo hauling capacity at a cost of road agility.

modules.name: Sleeper Bunks
modules.description: Tiered insulated bunks within the cabin allowing expedition crews to sleep safely in the field.

modules.name: Mobile Field Kitchenette
modules.description: Pressurized gas stove and fold-down stainless prep table for hot meal preparation on the trail.

modules.name: Trauma Triage Station
modules.description: Sanitized stretcher, surgical rack, and suture lights for stabilizing critically injured survivors.

modules.name: Pintle-Mounted Autocannon
modules.description: Swivel-mounted heavy kinetic gun on roof ring for deterring wasteland raiders and beasts.

modules.name: High-Torque Recovery Winch
modules.description: Heavy-duty electric drum and 50-meter steel cable for extricating mired vehicles from mud and ruins.

modules.name: Roof-Mounted Photovoltaics
modules.description: Monocrystalline solar cells charging auxiliary vehicle batteries to reduce engine alternator load.

modules.name: Expedition Comms Transceiver
modules.description: Telescoping antenna and 200W RF transceiver keeping the expedition in continuous touch with the holdfast.
